mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 315, it signals persistent inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors demand higher risk premiums to compensate for inflation erosion of real returns.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 315, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.1 percentage points in the past month and employment (PAYEMS) falls by more than 0.5% in the past month, it signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as economic weakness reduces corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.1pp increase in 1 month AND PAYEMS < 0.5% decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE rises >0.1pp and PAYEMS falls >0.5% in 1 month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as supply chain disruptions and reduced output dampen economic growth and corporate profits.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong housing activity signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting equity market sentiment.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between HOUST level and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300, it signals a strong housing market that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as robust housing activity supports consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1300, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit (RSAFS) rises by more than 0.5% in the past month and housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 0.5% in the past month, it signals a strong consumer sector that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as rising consumer spending and confidence drive economic growth and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 0.5% increase in 1 month AND HOUST > 0.5% increase in 1 month
failure_condition: In instances where RSAFS rises >0.5% and HOUST rises >0.5% in 1 month, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When gross domestic product (GDPC1) exceeds 23400.5 billion, it signals strong economic growth that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as robust GDP growth supports corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 23400.5, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
